title: Singapore summit onsite wallet and expense docket
content:
Purpose: quick pocket reference for on-site wallet management, taxi/merchant bookkeeping, booth vendor handoffs, and final reimbursement tasks for Singapore Partner Summit (Marina Bay).

High-level notes (to self)
- Keep petty cash envelope separate from team card receipts. Label envelope:"RW-SG-2024-PETTY".
- Primary card: Redwood corporate Visa ending 3241 (used for hotels, crates). Personal backup: AmEx (Riley) for incidentals if corp card declines.
- Per-diem: SGD 70/day (meals only) — capture receipts for anything > SGD 10.
- Expense code for summit: TRAVEL:SG-SUMMIT-2024. Use this exact code in Ramp/Expensify notes.

Pre-arrival checklist
- Confirm courier ETA for crates with Landmark Logistics (see vendor contacts). Pickup window: 48–72 hrs before show floor load-in.
- Upload floor map and crate photos to GitHub folder linked above.
- Print 10 vendor invoices (paper copies) to carry for reconciliation.
- Load offline contact sheet into phone (screenshot saved to SD card).

On-site wallet rules (team agreement)
- One wallet holder per team member for petty cash shifts. Shift times: 08:00–14:00, 14:00–20:00.
- Sign-out sheet in booth binder every time cash is exchanged.
- Record all card transactions in the daily expense ledger (photo + short note e.g., "Taxi to airport - Sam to SG airport - Ramp charge").
- Any reimbursement over SGD 200 needs team lead approval (Asha). Slack: #sg-summit-ops for rapid approvals.

Receipt capture conventions (must follow for finance)
- Photo needs: merchant name, date/time, total, last 4 of card. If digital receipt, forward to expenses@redwood.ai with subject: TRAVEL:SG: <date> <merchant>. Attach a photo of the card slip if available.
- File naming convention (local folder): YYYYMMDD_<merchant>_<last4>.jpg (e.g., 20240921_Grab_1234.jpg).

Local vendor contacts (quick dial)
- Landmark Logistics (crate pickup & material handling) — contact: Priya Raman +65 9123 4455, priya@landmark-logistics.sg, account ref: RW-SG-232
- Booth Builder (modular stand & signage) — contact: Tan Wei Long +65 9876 0012, weilang@boothx.sg, PO must include "RW Account 44"
- AV/Tech on-call — contact: Marcus Heng +65 9000 3322, av@eventtech.sg (ask for onsite tech 2 if main tech is busy)
- Local taxis (for receipts): Grab (app; use business profile), ComfortDelGro (+65 6552 1111) — ask driver for receipt SMS or take picture of meter.
- SIM / eSIM provider (temporary): Circles.Life pop-up at venue. Price ~ SGD 20 for 10GB.
- Emergency medical clinic: Raffles Medical Clinic (Marina Square) +65 6333 6666

Common expense scenarios & how to log them
- Booth crate freight paid to Landmark by corp card: tag as "SHIPPING - Equipment" and attach BOL + photo of crate label.
- Dinner with partner (business): attach attendee list (names + companies) in expense note. If > SGD 100 per person, include short sales justification.
- Taxis for attendees: capture receipt or screenshot; if attendee paid personal, reimburse under TRAVEL with "taxi-share" note and names.

Refunds, disputes, and chargebacks
- If vendor issues incorrect invoice, request corrected invoice with line items and vendor GST registration number. Save email thread and attach to expense.
- For card declines: take picture of declined screen + vendor receipt (if any) and record time + terminal id.

Post-event wrap (day +1 to +5)
- Day 1 post-event: collect all physical receipts, verify sign-out wallet log.
- Day 2: Upload receipts to Expensify (or Ramp) and tag with TRAVEL:SG-SUMMIT-2024.
- Day 3–5: Chase any missing receipts from team. Make a list of unresolved items and ping finance lead (Diego).
- Submit final spreadsheet with totals by category (Meals, Ground, Shipping, Booth services, Misc) to Confluence page linked above.

Open questions / TODOs (quick)
- Confirm whether Landmark will accept consolidated invoice for multiple pickups — Priya to confirm by Sept 20.
- Need petty cash float amount approval: propose SGD 600 for entire team. Asha to confirm by Sept 18.
- Who is primary for cross-border VAT documentation? (ask Finance).

Quick cash ledger template (copy this into booth binder)
- Date | Time | Holder | Amount IN | Amount OUT | Balance | Notes
- Example: 2024-09-22 | 09:05 | Riley | +SGD 500 | -SGD 22 (coffee) | SGD 478 | Grab receipt 20240922_Grab_1234.jpg

Notes-to-self (brain dump)
- Keep a spare set of branded lanyards in the wallet for quick partner swaps.
- Try to get digital invoices from booth builder to speed up finance sign-off.
- If we run out of petty cash, move to corporate card and note "PETTY-CASH-TRIGGER" in expense.

References & links
- Summit playbook (confluence) — linked above.
- Expense policy summary: search Confluence for "Travel & Expenses - 2024".
- Slack channel: #sg-summit-ops (pin this doc and vendor numbers).

End of docket — check this list again 48 hours before departure.

Unresolved scribbles: 
- Cheap backup power banks to hand out? (quantity 5)
- Confirm partner dinner reimbursement limit (was it SGD 150/person?)

(archive after event)
